summary: Two boys duck hunting on Clear Creek Reservoir capsized their canoe in 33-degree water and 20 mph wind; one boy was pulled out by his father and CPW officers, but 13-year-old Makalu Bowen was not found; a two-day multi-agency search ended Monday ~12:30 p.m. when CPW's MERT unit located his body in 35 ft of water ~270 yards offshore and Pueblo County Sheriff SAR divers recovered it.
location: Clear Creek Reservoir State Wildlife Area, 15 miles north of Buena Vista
notes: Date inferred (approximate): article carries no printed date; article UUID decodes to 2020-11-17 publication; incident Sat/Mon immediately before = 2020-11-14/16, Saturday-verified; method validated run 1013 against four indexed Mountain Mail rows (0-5 day lags); no dated corroboration found in parent searches. Also on scene: Chaffee County SAR North, Lake County SAR, Pueblo County Sheriff SAR dive team, Summit County SAR canine unit. Inserted run 1013 (Mountain Mail chunk).
